comment: Pinned inputs of the Android APK pipeline. Every download is verified: archives by SHA-256, git checkouts by commit id, Android SDK packages by exact revision (sdkmanager verifies each archive against the checksum in Google's repository manifest), Python wheels by pip --require-hashes. Change a pin here and nowhere else; tools/android/fetch_deps.py reads this file.

ndk.why: LTS line; still ships shader-tools/glslc, which r29+ dropped

cmdline_tools.only_if: no SDK with the pinned packages is already installed
cmdline_tools.sha256_source: published on https://developer.android.com/studio (Command line tools only), read 2026-11-14

SDL2.used_for: Android window/surface, input, audio (AAudio/OpenSL ES), SDLActivity Java glue

Vulkan-Headers.used_for: host (Linux) builds of the Vulkan back end; Android builds use the NDK's own headers

extract-xiso.used_for: optional cross-check extractor and XISO creation for test fixtures; tools/xiso is the default extractor

glslangValidator.used_for: regenerating the committed SPIR-V header src/vk/nv2a_vk_spv.h from src/vk/shaders (python3 -m tools.android.vk_shaders); builds do not need it

bionic-headers.license: BSD-2-Clause (bionic libc headers); kernel uapi headers carry their own notices
bionic-headers.used_for: compile-only ARM64/bionic API-level check of the runtime and generated code where no NDK can be installed (tools/android/native.py --mode check). Never linked; the NDK sysroot is authoritative on CI.

liblog-headers.used_for: <android/log.h> for the compile-only check (the NDK sysroot ships the same public header; AOSP's own repository is not on GitHub, LineageOS mirrors it). Never linked.
